text:
Alex: CI red on master for `serve_retry_backpressure_test` on macos-runner-12 — failing ~1/20 runs. Anyone grabbed this yet? https://ci.redwood/team/serve/job/456
CI-bot: Test failed: https://ci.redwood/team/serve/job/456/console 
--- log excerpt ---
thread 'test:serve_retry_backpressure_test' panicked at 'assertion failed: queue.is_empty()', tests/runtime/src/retry.rs:128
--- end ---
Sam: I hit this locally before. Quick repro: `cargo test serve_retry_backpressure_test -- --nocapture` on macOS sometimes flakes. Running with `--test-threads=1` reduces noise.
Mira: Can you paste the full stacktrace from one of the failures? I can take a bisect later if we need. @sam any env vars you used?
Sam: ran with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` and got: 
``
stack backtrace:
 0: retry::dispatch::on_timer
 1: runtime::timer::trigger
 2: std::panicking::begin_panic
``
Looks like the timer callback races with retry window plumbing. Also noticed the failing run had a 12ms scheduling spike.
Jon: fwiw PR #3124 changed timer coalescing in the dispatch loop — could be related. That change made some callbacks run in the shared worker thread instead of the timer thread.
Alex: Let's avoid touching production dispatch logic unless bisect points there. Can we make the test less timing-sensitive? Maybe swap to a mocked clock in the test harness. @Mira can you try a quick smoke with mock clock to see if it stabilizes?
Mira: Will try now. Kicking local runs (10 iterations). Will report back.
QA-bot: Mira started a local run: https://ci.redwood/local/serve/789 (10 iterations queued)
Mira: Run 1–10: 9/10 passed, 1 intermittent fail (same assertion). Pasted failing log to Gist: https://gist.github.com/mira/abc123 
Sam: If mock clock stabilizes it means scheduling jitter is the culprit. Quick mitigation: change test to allow `<= 2` in-flight rather than strict empty check, or assert eventual emptiness with a short poll loop. Example patch: `assert!(queue.is_empty() || try_wait_for_empty(Duration::from_millis(50)));`
Jon: That sounds reasonable as a short-term fix. Long-term we should add deterministic timer tests using the fake clock.
Alex: Agreed. @sam can you open a tiny PR with the relaxed assertion + a TODO to switch to mocked clock? Keep it behind a clear comment.
Sam: Yep I'll open PR and link here. Using `git bisect` next if this keeps failing.
Mira: I can run `git bisect` this afternoon if you want to share the bad/good tips.
Alex: Thanks — assigning to @Mira and @Sam to own the immediate triage. Please paste the bisect result or PR link here. :thumbsup:
QA-bot: Kicked a CI rerun for master (no changes) — current result: 1/20 failing reproductions, posting updates in this thread.
Sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/3789 — relaxes timing assertion + TODO comment. Will run matrix.
Mira: I'll start bisect after lunch and post findings.
Alex: Good plan. If bisect blames #3124 we'll escalate. Otherwise keep the test patch and follow up with a mock-clock refactor ticket.
Jon: ping me if you need help with the bisect script, I have a small helper to speed it up.
Alex: thanks all, closing loop for now.
